mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.1%) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 10.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a severe labor market shock that triggers a flight to quality in equities, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 10.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a collapsing real estate sector, which reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: During a manufacturing supply shock (INDPRO below 90.0 for two consecutive months), production constraints reduce corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 90.0 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average signals robust economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it signals a potential shift to a tighter monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a severe labor market deterioration, which reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-pandemic recovery phase (as indicated by rising HOUST and RSAFS), consumer demand rebounds, boosting corporate revenues and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS rise in the same month.
